name: Hau song
summary: Hàu sống is raw oysters on Đầm Lập An, with lemon or with soy sauce and wasabi, though VietnamPlus says the Lang Co way is its own. Nhân Dân says the lagoon farms rock oysters only, and that raw eating suits the milk oyster.
origin: Lang Co, on Đầm Lập An. VietnamPlus, 9 February 2016, and Nhân Dân, 5 July 2024. The two accounts of which oyster is eaten raw both stay.
howToEat: Nhân Dân’s farmer says the lagoon raises rock oysters only. A cook in the same piece says the milk oyster, not the rock oyster, suits raw eating.
seoTitle: Hau song in Lang Co — raw oysters
seoDescription: Hàu sống is raw oysters on Đầm Lập An. VietnamPlus and Nhân Dân differ on the milk oyster and the rock oyster.
